results.name: StrictMode hydrates once and initializes one verified project
double restore submission activates exactly one copy
edits during prerequisite save stop replacement and remain open
edits during candidate verification retain candidate without activating it
edits while promotion awaits completion stay open and can fork from fresh authority
cross-writer conflict preserves unsaved work and fork saves it separately
unmount aborts pending save and ignores its callback
retry cancels old hydration and stale candidate cannot activate
unmount after committed promotion cannot restore into the old component
failed and unexpectedly rejected saves never claim saved or enable replacement
named copy preserves all fields without moving active pointer or save receipt
document-only properties survive partial UI capture and reset on explicit replacement
